name: Save Profiles
author: After juvxncio's zelda-oot-perfis (GPL-3.0-or-later)
description: An N64-style file select with 7 files when the game starts; a pick opens that file's save list, and B on it comes back. Each file is its own game: its own saves, settings and progress. In co-op the host shares the file it picked; guests play the host's save as before.

settings.name: Skip the file select
settings.help: On: no file select at the start; the game opens the file you played last. Off (the default): pick a file each time the game starts.
